text:
All-cash merger consideration of $10.90 per Share; Excluded Shares receive no payment; Rollover Shares are contributed to the Parent; outstanding RSUs, PSUs, and Bonus Units may be cash-settled as described; no stock or CVRs are issued as Merger Consideration.
Merger Consideration components: 1) Merger Consideration: $10.90 in cash per Share. 2) Stock exchange ratio: each share of Merger Sub outstanding shall be exchanged and converted into one share of common stock of the Surviving Company. 3) Company RSU Consideration: cash equal to the product of the Shares underlying such RSU by Merger Consideration, plus accrued dividend equivalents. 4) Company PSU Consideration: cash equal to the product of the Shares underlying such PSU by Merger Consideration, plus accrued dividend equivalents. 5) Cancelled RSU/PSU Consideration. 6) Company Bonus Unit Consideration. 7) Dissenting Shares: appraised value paid under DGCL. 8) Final Dividend (if applicable) funded from the Payment Fund.
There is no stock-based exchange ratio; each Share outstanding at the Effective Time is cancelled and exchanged for $10.90 in cash per Share (Merger Consideration).
